etymologies.etymologyHTML: From photograph +‎ -er, from Ancient Greek φωτός (phōtós), genitive singular of φῶς (phôs, “light”) (fōs) and γράφω (gráphō, “I write”).

definitions.definition: (photography) One who takes photographs, typically as an occupation.

quote.citation: 2015 July 3, “The Outside Land”, in The Guardian‎[1]:
quote.text: Award-winning Sydney photographer Stephen Dupont’s latest exhibition focuses on change and detribalisation in Papua New Guinea .

quote.citation: 2024 July 15, Aïda Amer, “How photographers view the photos of Trump's assassination attempt”, in Axios‎[2]:
quote.text: Multiple photographers worried privately in conversations with Axios that the images from the rally could turn into a kind of "photoganda," with the Trump campaign using them to further their agenda despite the photographers' intent of capturing a news event.
